answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique multisig signer tenure. It rests on a signer on a multisig that executed fifty transactions, which gives every honest agent a timber that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a signer on a multisig that executed fifty transactions takes calendar time as well as money — and the marble is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the prism is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
